entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R Case No.08 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, arising out of K.Nuagaon P.S.
Case No.08 of 2023 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/417 IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned ADJ-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, by order dated 10.02.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 11.01.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 10.03.2023, his further continuance in custody is not warranted.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
7.
Considering the tenor thereof and filing of the charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin.

Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin and shall not threaten the victim and/or her family members.
